name: Achtung, die Kurve!
description: Steer a growing curve, avoid every trail, last one alive scores. Arena grows with the player count.

name: Ring Rumble
description: A 3D arena brawler. Punch your friends off the platform, dash out of trouble, and be the last fighter standing.

name: Prism Post
description: Slide your cart to catch mint parcels and dodge costly glitches in identical delivery bays, racing friends to 20 points across thirty-second shifts.

name: Vault Tempo
description: Drill volatile rich veins, manage rising heat, and bank your haul before meltdown in a multiplayer push-your-luck mining race.

name: Counterstrike: Breach
description: A first-person 3D team shooter. Buy weapons and armor, take a bombsite, or race to defuse. First team to five rounds wins.

name: Switchback Regatta
description: Race skiffs through ordered buoy rings, steer around reefs and shifting currents, and win a two-lap regatta against your friends.

name: Relay Orbit
description: Steer a momentum-driven antenna into shared broadcast windows, brake for precise transmissions, and race friends to 60 points across ten-pulse rounds.

name: Short Fuse
description: Hot-potato tag with a live bomb: pass it by touch before the fuse burns out, and haunt the survivors after you pop.

name: Trapdoor
description: Stand on the called shape before the floor drops; shove your rivals into the pit.

name: Velvet Auction
description: Seal all-pay bids for rare blooms, cancel matching rivals, and win petals with the highest unique offer in an eight-lot flower auction.

name: Echo Loom
description: Watch a stitch pattern, weave it from memory with three shape keys, and out-recall your friends across five increasingly intricate patterns.
